scenes.say: Automated accessibility tools scan for issues, but can they catch everything? What do they miss?

scenes.label: axe
scenes.sub: Finds missing alt text or ARIA labels fast
scenes.say: Tools like axe quickly find missing alt text or ARIA labels on your pages.

scenes.title: Run axe on a page
scenes.say: For example, running n-p-x axe highlights missing ARIA labels or alt attributes.
But tools can't judge focus order or if labels are meaningful. Manual testing fills those gaps.

scenes.question: Can tools check all accessibility?
scenes.right: No, manual checks catch logic and meaning issues.
scenes.say: Here's a common interview trap: Can tools check all accessibility? No—they miss logic and meaning issues. Manual checks are always needed.
